text: What do you do with your anger? You don't, you don't suppress it, you don't express it. What do we learn from this psalm? This psalm is intense, but realize that the psalmist is saying, "I'm not the one who's making it right, I'm not the one who's settling the score." Here's what you learn: because you're going to have anger at being mistreated, you're going to have anger just with a broken and fallen world. Don't suppress or express your anger. Address your anger. Don't suppress it, just don't express it.
